claims.text: Many reviewers praise the drill's power and performance, with several professionals saying it compares to name-brand high-end drills.
A recurring complaint is that the drill stops working or won't power back on after a period of use, sometimes within months or even on first use.
Several reviewers report the lowest speed setting is still too fast, making it difficult to control.
Reviewers frequently note the product is good value for the money and comes with many accessories.
Some reviewers mention issues with included bits not fitting the drill or being low quality.
